_comment: Caps for the India paper-trading track. Not CI-enforced yet (see README_IN.md) but core_in/validate.py checks it locally the same way core/validate.py checks config/protected.json. Treat this file the way the operator treats config/protected.json: raising a cap is a deliberate decision, not something the agent talks itself into during a cycle.

lot_sizes._comment: NSE revises these periodically (most recently for NIFTY/BANKNIFTY in 2025). VERIFY against the current NSE circular before placing anything real — a stale lot size silently changes your real position size.

real._comment: Mirrors config/protected.json's real block. Left in place so flipping this on later is a config change, not a redesign. core_in/validate.py enforces these as hard ceilings; core_in/broker_angelone.py refuses to place a real order unless real_trading_enabled is true AND these are all present.
